Also may throw RuntimeException if schemaNode is malformed. Also could throw SecurityException? Not likely.

We need to design test cases that trigger each identified exception. Use mocking to make obtainSubSchemaNode throw exceptions. Since it's private static, we can use PowerMockito to mock static method to throw. So test cases:

3. When obtainSubSchemaNode throws RuntimeException (e.g., unexpected error). Expect RuntimeException.
4. When suppressSubSchemaRetrieval = true, even if obtainSubSchemaNode would throw, it's not called, so no exception. Already covered.

Also maybe when validationContext is null and obtainSubSchemaNode throws IllegalArgumentException for null context. So test case.
